hook: Viral social media posts claiming 453 recalls in October 2026 contradict official government data.

sections.voiceover: Viral social media posts claiming 453 recalls in October 2026 contradict official government data.
The FDA issued 274 medical device recall records, which stemmed from 81 distinct recall events. Why do these official figures differ so drastically from the viral 453 recall claim?
U.S. federal agencies actually reported only 138 total recall events by October 29, 2026.
Between October 5 and October 11, 2026, agencies published 281 official recalls and safety alerts.
Total official U.S. recall events reached 138 by October 29.
